dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: I must find a way to resolve these engineering issues, post-haste...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What issues?

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Why that of the high-altitude aqueducts, of course! These will become key arteries for Remuria, allowing purveyors, pedestrians, and pilgrims alike to pass.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: But there are still a great many issues to solve. First, materials! Then, the bridge support schematics...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A high-altitude aqueduct, here?

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: We're still in the design phase, of course. I shall have to undertake some discussions to perfect the plans before construction begins.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Ah... What an investment of resources and manpower.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Such wonders are only possible thanks to our God King's grace. I am truly blessed to have been granted the opportunity to dedicate my life to this work...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: See you, outlander. Watch yourself on the road.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Speaking of cannons, the bigger the better, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: C—Cannons? What sort?

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: The sort that'll blast cannonballs up into the skies! I intend to place the gun mount here, um... Well, maybe a bit farther away, but not too far.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: After that, we'll have to draw up a restricted zone. When that cannon fires, the spherical blast wave is going to be quite strong.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: We'll have to place the audience in suitable positions...

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Such that they can view the firing without fear that their hats might get blown clean off.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I... don't see anything.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Of course. The cannon is still in the design phase.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: I am also looking into the materials we'll need to make that cannon. They need to be sufficiently hard and heat-resistant...

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Or our cannon would get off one shot, then "boom," it'd be a goner.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: I'm even considering placing the cannon in the shallows, or perhaps directly in water! That way, it should be easier to cool off, and we can transport cannonballs by water. Truly, nothing but benefits from doing so!

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Of course, I'll have to solve the problem of forging the cannon itself first...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like you're in good shape now.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Haha! Indeed I am. More experiences mean more inspiration for more research.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: I must say that the inspiration I got from "that fellow" is... outdated in some places, but it was useful overall.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Once I'm done with my cannon, I'll draw up designs for that high-altitude waterway.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: I doubt I could build a new aquabus line completely... but a scale model should be doable.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: I shall show him the power of "daydreams," hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: See you! Do come visit once the cannon is complete — I'll save you a special seat!

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: That's right. You just couldn't learn to "daydream"... There's no lack of reality all around us. You just lacked that power to dream...
